_comment: Hand-set values merged into catalog.json by tools/sync_catalog.py (keys starting with _ are ignored).

polytrack._why: Polytrack checks its 3D models with crypto.subtle.digest, which only exists on secure pages. An extension page is an opaque NavigateToString document, so no frame inside it is a secure context; the game crashes there but runs in a normal PhantomHaze tab.

minecraft-classic._why: Runs classic.minecraft.net, which the arcade cannot test offline: offer a tab as a fallback.

vent-crawlers-beta._why: Runs on arcade.makecode.com: offer a tab as a fallback.

arrow-battles._why: Runs on arcade.makecode.com: offer a tab as a fallback.

suggestion-box._why: Embeds a Microsoft Forms page: offer a tab as a fallback.
